build_SOLOHead: build a SOLO mask head instance with configurable num_classes, in_channels, and num_grids for instance segmentation
build_DecoupledSOLOHead: build a DecoupledSOLO mask head that predicts separate x and y mask branches for instance segmentation
build_DecoupledSOLOLightHead: build a lightweight DecoupledSOLO head with optional deformable conv support for efficient instance segmentation
review_SOLOHead_forward: review the SOLOHead forward method that generates multi-level mask and classification predictions from FPN features
test_SOLOHead_loss_by_feat: test the SOLOHead loss calculation combining DiceLoss for masks and FocalLoss for classification scores
